cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import compiler
from compiler import Dinic
d = json.load(open('tmp/hard32.json'))
links = [tuple(x) for x in d['links']]
env = {int(k): v for k, v in d['env'].items()}
parts = {int(k): v for k, v in d['parts'].items()}
n = 48
D = sum(parts.values())
sigma, tau = n, n+1
total_cap = sum(env.get(i,0) for i in range(len(links)))
INF = D + total_cap + 1
participants = sorted(parts)
w = 17
g = Dinic(n+2)
for idx,(a,b,c) in enumerate(links):
    cp = env.get(idx,0)
    if cp>0:
        g.add(a,b,cp); g.add(b,a,cp)
for v in participants:
    if parts[v]>0: g.add(sigma,v,parts[v])
g.add(w, tau, INF)
val = g.maxflow(sigma, tau)
S = g.source_side(sigma)
print('mincut value', val, 'D', D)
print('w in S?', w in S, 'sigma in S?', sigma in S)
Sv = set(x for x in S if x < n)
print('|S| vertices:', len(Sv))
crossing = sum(env.get(i,0) for i,(u,v,c) in enumerate(links) if (u in S) != (v in S))
d1 = sum(parts[v] for v in S if v in parts)
print('crossing', crossing, 'demand in S', d1)
print('participants in S:', sorted(v for v in S if v in parts))
EOF
